subject: Debrief & recommendation: Daniel Chen (Backend Staff SWE) - next steps
body:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hana Morales <hana@recruitco.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Debrief: Daniel Chen (Backend Staff SWE) - quick sync and scorecards

Hi all —

Thanks again for joining the loop on Daniel's on-site. Quick ask: please drop your numeric score + 1–2 bullet rationales in the attached scorecard by EOD. We need to close a hiring recommendation for CS by tomorrow so Hana can schedule the final reference check / offer conversation if we greenlight.

Key spots to call out in the scorecard: systems design reliability tradeoffs, long-lived state and migrations, and cross-team communication. If you have a hard veto, flag it explicitly in the "recommendation" field.

Attachments: scorecard-template.pdf (please save as "scorecard-daniel-chen-[yourname].pdf")

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Talent Partner (Hiring Ops)
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Debrief: Daniel Chen (Backend Staff SWE) - quick sync and scorecards

Jasmine — thanks, uploaded my card.

Score summary (laura_bennett): 7/10
- Strengths: clear mental model on service ownership, thoughtful about upgrade/migration patterns, good debugging examples.
- Concerns: slower on distributed tracing nuances and some follow-up on observability tradeoffs.
- Recommendation: advance to reference check; no veto.

Attachment: scorecard-daniel-chen-laura.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 13:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Debrief: Daniel Chen (Backend Staff SWE) - quick sync and scorecards

Uploaded my card — quick notes here so it's clear in the thread: 6/10.

- Systems design: Daniel chose a pragmatic consistency model for the migration, which is fine, but didn't articulate the rollback path in high-latency scenarios; wanted to hear more about throttling/backpressure.
- Coding exercise: solid, but several micro-optimizations left unexplored (which I would expect at staff level).
- Collaboration: good cross-team examples but a little light on measurable outcomes (OKRs/impact).

Veto? No, but leaning close — I'd recommend reference check focused on reliability escalations and a brief follow-up on tracing implementation.

Attachment: scorecard-daniel-chen-aditya.pdf

Thanks — added my notes. 8/10 from me.

- Strong ownership examples, repeatedly drove cross-service rollouts.
- Asked good questions around schema evolution.
- Small nits on deep profiling but those are coachable.

No veto. Happy to move forward.

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>

Cc: Hana Morales <hana@recruitco.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 16:28:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Debrief: Daniel Chen (Backend Staff SWE) - quick sync and scorecards

Appreciate the fast turnarounds — consolidating and calling recommendation: MOVE FORWARD TO REFERENCE CHECK.

Consensus (simple average of numeric scores): (7 + 6 + 8) / 3 = 7.0
Panel notes:
- Action 1: Aditya to add 2 specific follow-up questions on tracing/reliability for references (ETA tomorrow 10am PT).
- Action 2: Hana to schedule 2 reference calls (preferably with manager who oversaw migrations and a peer) and hold tentative offer window until references complete.
- Action 3: Laura to add interview summary to GH application and flag the three micro-questions we want validated.

I've attached the compiled CSV with the numeric breakdown + export for GH: compiled-scorecard-daniel-chen.csv

If anyone has a last-minute strong objection, reply-all within the hour; otherwise I'll mark "reference check" in Greenhouse and pass to Hana.

Attachments: compiled-scorecard-daniel-chen.csv

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Talent Partner (Hiring Ops)
